original.statement: Support for GitLab System Hook webhooks for ApplicationSets has been added to Argo CD.

decision.reason: [ev-ff04fee04e63] says Argo CD now supports GitLab "System Hook" webhooks for ApplicationSets. Although the changelog files it as a fix, this is new webhook-handling support, so "added" on a protocol-behavior subject fits. The name gitlab-system-hook-webhook is kebab-case built from the entry's own words and is unambiguous within this evidence. Validators were inconclusive (this behaviour can't be checked against rendered artifacts) and contradict nothing.
